subject: Error running multiple cores on Linux

messages.author: 4b681bcd9d4d425d
messages.subject: Error running multiple cores on Linux
parts:
The model runs, except on the Linux machine I have access to, when using multiple cores.

I'm getting the error; (Once per core) 
starting worker pid=23479 on localhost:11573 at 14:16:00.322
Warning: namespace ‘rstan’ is not available and has been replaced
by .GlobalEnv when processing object ‘’

Any ideas what this is? It seems to have to do with how the environments for the individual threads are being spawned, but I can't figure out what.

Thanks,
David

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Error running multiple cores on Linux
parts:
On Monday, February 1, 2016 at 5:20:50 PM UTC-5, David Manheim wrote:
The model runs, except on the Linux machine I have access to, when using multiple cores.

I'm getting the error; (Once per core) 
starting worker pid=23479 on localhost:11573 at 14:16:00.322
Warning: namespace ‘rstan’ is not available and has been replaced
by .GlobalEnv when processing object ‘’

This happens when the child process is either loading an old version of rstan or can't
find any rstan installation at all. Do you have rstan installed in some odd location on the
Linux server?

Ben
